answer.exemplar: A 2005 study of 450 retirees at gatherings in West Africa found 58% acted in line with the crowd, while 30% acted independently. This illustrates collective behavior: relatively spontaneous action by a crowd or mass. A careful reading links the group-level pattern to the wider social structure rather than to any single person, and it distinguishes this idea from competing accounts that locate the cause elsewhere.

questions.explanation: The finding illustrates collective behavior: relatively spontaneous action by a crowd or mass. The 58 percent versus 30 percent split in West Africa shows why this reading fits better than the alternatives.
questions.hint: Think about the social force behind the two figures.
